title: DynamicISF safety limiter bug
symptom: When selecting the DynamicISF option, the safety limiter is set to 1.5 (for a user with max basal 10U), which may come from basal rate (0.5) times max multiplier (3). This prevents SMBs and high basals. With OpenSMB, the limiter goes to 22.
cause: The thread does not explicitly identify the root cause, but it is implied to be a bug in the DynamicISF calculation of the safety limiter.
fix: The thread does not state a definitive fix. A user (swissalpine) mentions a commit that works for them, but no official resolution is given.
evidence_quote: If I select the DynamicISF option, I have a safety limiter at 1.5 (mine is 10U) which may (or may not) come from my basal rate (0.5) x max multiplier (3).
